//go:build postingedgebench && darwin

package postingedge

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/adapters/repos/db/vector/hnsw/distancer"
	enterrors "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/errors"
	ent "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/vectorindex/postingedge"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/usecases/byteops"
)

// The recall and the loads of the index TestNightGrow left (bench-report.md
// of feat/posting-edge-index, "10M crecido por inserts, con la serie",
// amendment of 2026-11-27): nothing here is timed.
//
// Parameters, from the environment, besides those of TestNightGrow:
//   - PE_POINTS: the JSON written at the end.
//   - PE_THREADS: how many queries run at once (8).

// nightPoint is the index at one ef: its recall against the neighbors the
// dataset ships, and what a query did, on average.
type nightPoint struct {
	// Target is the recall the point was looked for, 0 for an ef that was
	// only tried on the way.
	Target float64 `json:"target,omitempty"`
	EF     int     `json:"ef"`
	Recall float64 `json:"recall"`
	// Loads is the postings a query loaded, the entry postings aside, as the
	// other measures count them; Rounds the rounds they came in.
	Loads  float64 `json:"loads"`
	Rounds float64 `json:"rounds"`
	// Members is the members of those postings, Rescored the exact vectors
	// read, and BlockBytes the bytes of the blocks the store returned.
	Members    float64 `json:"members"`
	Rescored   float64 `json:"rescored"`
	BlockBytes float64 `json:"blockBytes"`
}

type nightPoints struct {
	Dir          string       `json:"dir"`
	Dataset      string       `json:"dataset"`
	CacheMode    string       `json:"cacheMode"`
	Meta         growMeta     `json:"meta"`
	LivePostings int          `json:"livePostings"`
	Deleted      int          `json:"deleted"`
	Queries      int          `json:"queries"`
	K            int          `json:"k"`
	Threads      int          `json:"threads"`
	Points       []nightPoint `json:"points"`
	// Tried has every ef that was tried, in the order it was.
	Tried []nightPoint `json:"tried"`
}

// readNightQueries reads the queries of a raw dataset and, for each, the
// first k of the neighbors it ships.
func readNightQueries(t *testing.T, dir string, k int) (queries [][]float32, truth [][]uint64, trainRows int) {
	t.Helper()
	meta, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(dir, "meta.txt"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer meta.Close()
	shapes := map[string][2]int{}
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(meta)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(scanner.Text())
		if len(fields) != 3 {
			continue
		}
		a, errA := strconv.Atoi(fields[1])
		b, errB := strconv.Atoi(fields[2])
		if errA == nil && errB == nil {
			shapes[fields[0]] = [2]int{a, b}
		}
	}
	require.NoError(t, scanner.Err())
	test, neighbors := shapes["test"], shapes["neighbors"]
	require.Positive(t, test[0], "%s: no test line in meta.txt", dir)
	require.Equal(t, test[0], neighbors[0], "%s: a row of neighbors for every query", dir)
	require.GreaterOrEqual(t, neighbors[1], k, "%s: the dataset ships fewer than %d neighbors", dir, k)

	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "test.f32"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	rows, dims := test[0], test[1]
	require.Len(t, raw, 4*rows*dims, "test.f32")
	queries = make([][]float32, rows)
	for q := range queries {
		vec := make([]float32, dims)
		byteops.CopyBytesToSlice(vec, raw[4*q*dims:4*(q+1)*dims])
		queries[q] = distancer.Normalize(vec)
	}

	raw, err = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "neighbors.i32"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	width := neighbors[1]
	require.Len(t, raw, 4*rows*width, "neighbors.i32")
	truth = make([][]uint64, rows)
	for q := range truth {
		truth[q] = make([]uint64, k)
		for i := range truth[q] {
			truth[q][i] = uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(raw[4*(q*width+i):]))
		}
	}
	return queries, truth, shapes["train"][0]
}

// TestNightPoints finds, untimed, the operating points of the index
// TestNightGrow left at recall 0.95 and 0.99, each the smallest ef that
// reaches it, as TestTablesPoints does, and what a query does at each. It
// opens the index as TestNightHeap does, with no cycle running, and with no
// maintenance: nothing lays the vectors out or cleans while it searches. The
// neighbors the dataset ships are those of every row, so the index must hold
// them all.
func TestNightPoints(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_POINTS")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR and PE_POINTS given")
	}
	const k = 10
	ctx := context.Background()
	threads := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_THREADS", 8))
	queries, truth, trainRows := readNightQueries(t, datasetDir, k)

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, false)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	cfg.noMaintenance = true
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() {
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
	}()

	p.mu.RLock()
	g := p.g
	require.NotNil(t, g, "the index has a base")
	deleted := 0
	for _, d := range g.deleted {
		if d {
			deleted++
		}
	}
	result := &nightPoints{
		Dir: dir, Dataset: datasetDir, CacheMode: uc.RQ.CacheMode, Meta: g.meta, Deleted: deleted,
		Queries: len(queries), K: k, Threads: threads,
	}
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	result.LivePostings = livePostings(g)
	require.Zero(t, deleted, "the neighbors of the dataset are over every row")
	require.Equal(t, trainRows, result.Meta.Live, "the neighbors of the dataset are over every row, and the index holds %d of %d",
		result.Meta.Live, trainRows)

	at := func(ef int) nightPoint {
		searching := uc
		searching.EF = ef
		require.NoError(t, p.UpdateUserConfig(searching, func() {}))
		stats := make([]diskSearchStats, len(queries))
		ids := make([][]uint64, len(queries))
		errs := make([]error, threads)
		var next atomic.Int64
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		begin := time.Now()
		for worker := 0; worker < threads; worker++ {
			wg.Add(1)
			enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for {
					q := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
					if q >= len(queries) {
						return
					}
					p.mu.RLock()
					found, _, err := p.g.search(ctx, queries[q], k, &stats[q])
					p.mu.RUnlock()
					if err != nil {
						errs[worker] = err
						return
					}
					ids[q] = found
				}
			}, logger)
		}
		wg.Wait()
		for _, err := range errs {
			require.NoError(t, err)
		}
		point := nightPoint{EF: ef}
		hits := 0
		for q := range queries {
			for _, want := range truth[q] {
				if slices.Contains(ids[q], want) {
					hits++
				}
			}
			point.Loads += float64(stats[q].Postings)
			point.Rounds += float64(stats[q].Rounds)
			point.Members += float64(stats[q].Members)
			point.Rescored += float64(stats[q].Rescored)
			point.BlockBytes += float64(stats[q].BlockBytes)
		}
		n := float64(len(queries))
		point.Recall = float64(hits) / (n * k)
		point.Loads, point.Rounds, point.Members = point.Loads/n, point.Rounds/n, point.Members/n
		point.Rescored, point.BlockBytes = point.Rescored/n, point.BlockBytes/n
		result.Tried = append(result.Tried, point)
		t.Logf("ef %d: recall %.4f, %.2f loads a query in %.2f rounds, %.0f members, %.0f vectors read, %.0f KB of blocks (%s)",
			ef, point.Recall, point.Loads, point.Rounds, point.Members, point.Rescored, point.BlockBytes/1e3,
			time.Since(begin).Round(time.Millisecond))
		return point
	}

	for _, target := range []float64{0.95, 0.99} {
		// The first ef that reaches the target, doubling, and then the
		// smallest between it and the one before.
		low, high := k-1, k
		reached := at(high)
		for reached.Recall < target {
			low, high = high, 2*high
			require.LessOrEqual(t, high, 4096, "the index does not reach recall %.2f", target)
			reached = at(high)
		}
		for high-low > 1 {
			mid := (low + high) / 2
			if point := at(mid); point.Recall >= target {
				high, reached = mid, point
			} else {
				low = mid
			}
		}
		reached.Target = target
		result.Points = append(result.Points, reached)
		t.Logf("recall %.2f: ef %d, recall %.4f, %.2f loads a query", target, reached.EF, reached.Recall, reached.Loads)
	}
	writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
}
